P1.decision: For one public step h, use two outer characteristic half-panels: q1→mid over h/2 and mid→q3 over h/2. Each half-panel invokes the existing implicit-midpoint donor with public substeps=1 and retains its source-owned fixed-point bisection up to MAX_MIDPOINT_BISECTIONS=8.
required_falsifiers: q1/mid/q3 knot mutation changes the expected trajectory
forward-then-reverse returns the input within the preregistered norm
P1.why_not_candidate_tuning: The decision follows the public q1/mid/q3 data model and time-reversal symmetry; the smaller reported panel-16 error is corroborating, not the authority source.

P2.decision: The native trajectory does not choose among the three admissible builders. A caller/preprocessor supplies a serialized content-addressed CSR remap plan. Runtime owns validation and execution only.
row_requirements: inactive entries represented by absence, not tiny signed weights
P2.scientific_rule: Different valid plans are different numerical inputs and must produce different execution identities; they are never silently equated.

P3.decision: For each serialized plan, compute d_min=min(source_direction·target_direction) over strictly positive-weight entries. Serialize minimum_transport_dot as the immediate binary64 predecessor of d_min. Runtime recomputes d_min with the source dot implementation and verifies the one-ULP downward rule.
rejected: historical antipodal-only default for a narrower stencil

P4.G_h: fixed-Eulerian semi-Lagrangian geometric pullback: backtrace every target direction through q3→mid→q1 with the two-half profile, apply the serialized convex source plan at the backtraced source, common-screen remap there, then apply the characteristic spatial transport and bolometric factor to the fixed target direction.
decision: Y2 = exp[(h/2) opacity_scale opacity_mid C(mid)] Y1
Y4 = exp[(h/2) opacity_scale opacity_mid C(mid)] Y3
separation: geometric screen transport belongs only to G_h
equilibrium-projector Kato belongs only to K
no operator is inferred from a diagnostic alias
P4.why_this_order: It is the minimal palindromic second-order extension compatible with endpoint Kato data q1/q3, midpoint opacity/collision data, the existing scalar endpoint-Kato precedent, and one full geometric pullback.

P5.decision: Every accepted public radiation_history row is represented on the unchanged caller direction grid and its canonical screen carrier. Backtraced/evolved directions are transient step data, not public state.
P5.evolved_lagrangian: A future distinct route/schema only; unsupported by the current public history shape and therefore not an RF-04 v2 alias.
P5.restart: Restart state is fixed-grid radiation, accepted step index, source plan identities, background cursor and geometry-receipt chain head. No transient Lagrangian direction is silently promoted to state.
